scope: Frozen synthetic planar contact kernels, not collision discovery, a trajectory benchmark, Vektor compiler, WASM or GPU
automatic_friction_dispatch: Decoupled bounded tangent QP only when normal/tangent mobility cross-block has exact zero nonzeros; otherwise semismooth solve. No discarded small coupling.

held_out_stress.geometry: Random algebraic off-centre contact graph, not authenticated physical shape geometry

decision: Report solve and cold assembly-plus-solve medians, every sample, matrix array storage, all failures and equal-accuracy ratios. Keep original dense and same-algorithm dense controls distinct. Do not count an unverified result as a performance winner.
limitations: Coulomb uses one coefficient and zero restitution, no elastic history or rolling couple. Rigid redundant normal pressures can be nonunique; the active-set initialization selects a pressure gauge, not a uniquely identified material force. Timing and explicit matrix storage exclude process startup and do not measure full engine throughput or peak resident memory.
